description.value: The Travelodge by Wyndham Quesnel is a national chain hotel situated on Front Street in Quesnel, a regional service hub in BC's Cariboo region along the Gold Rush Trail corridor. As a Travelodge property it offers standard roadside hotel amenities and participates in the Wyndham Rewards loyalty program. Touring cyclists passing through the Cariboo will find it a convenient overnight stop in a town with good access to supplies and services.
